project_type: Electron desktop app with Firebase backend for warehouse inventory management
language: JavaScript (ES modules in renderer, CommonJS in main process)
build_system: electron-builder for packaging; no compile step for renderer JS
test_framework: Custom assert-based test runner in test/logic.test.js (tests pdfParser only)
build_command: No build step needed - renderer JS runs directly in Electron/browser
test_command: npm test (runs node test/logic.test.js - tests pdfParser logic only)
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm test to confirm existing tests still pass. 2. Verify syntax of renderer.js with node --check (ES module syntax check). 3. Verify the voice assistant code is syntactically correct by checking for balanced braces/parens.
environment_constraints: This is an Electron app - cannot run the full app in sandbox (needs display). Verification limited to syntax checks and existing tests. The renderer.js uses browser APIs (Web Speech API, DOM) not available in Node.
contribution_requirements: Push directly to main branch. Update cache-buster from ?v=47 to ?v=48 in index.html.
key_patterns: - $ = document.querySelector shorthand (line 91). - normTxt(s) normalizes text: NFD strip diacritics, lowercase, trim (line 1878). - estado.materiales = array of {id, nombre, cantidad, unidad, esHerramienta, serial, categoria, minimo}. - modalOrden(tipo, precarga) opens order modal (line 1939). - registrarOrden({tipo, frente, contrato, proveedor, responsable, responsables, nota, usuario, items, fecha}) in db.js. - contratoDeFrente(frente) resolves contract from frente. - Voice assistant code block starts at line ~3414 ending at ~4175. - CLOUD_FUNCTION_URL for complex AI commands. - hablarAgente(texto) returns Promise, uses SpeechSynthesis. - llenarCampoPorVoz handles filling form fields. - ejecutarDirectoIA(json) executes orders directly without modal.
relevant_files: src/renderer/db.js (registrarOrden function - called for order creation)
directory_structure: Root: package.json, firebase.json. src/main/ = Electron main process. src/renderer/ = UI (index.html, renderer.js ~4175 lines, styles.css, auth.js, db.js, firebase-config.js). functions/ = Cloud Functions. test/ = logic tests.
